content: The FMC-R regimen, also known by synonyms such as FCMR regimen, FCM-R regimen, FMC-R regimen, or R-FCM regimen, refers to a specific combination chemotherapy protocol. This regimen includes the drugs fludarabine, mitoxantrone, cyclophosphamide, and rituximab. It is primarily utilized in the treatment of resistant or relapsed chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL). The components of the regimen are as follows: F: Fludarabine M: Mitoxantrone C: Cyclophosphamide R: Rituximab The FMC-R regimen is also indicated for the treatment of indolent non-Hodgkin's lymphoma, as well as relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma.
